notes.title: 1.1.2 补丁 太阳挑战模式已上线
notes.content:
[p] A Sun Challenge mode has been updated. New levels will be added here in the future to try out new mechanisms

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585074/7ab2542185432d01b35a3b54d22320f645ab7e23.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585074/0c5273b7bdaad6b311161d1494538211f82fea8c.gif[/img]

A new "like water" level has been added
It's extremely extraordinary and extremely difficult
The 18 F-steps are guaranteed to be unclimbable

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585074/462b9d187248992af10d3e30cc9cd2db1cfda195.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585074/bf8b022cf704341af05e96b652d2e4641d1450b5.png[/img]


Fixed the bug that occurred in the probability of the card-drawing system
Many module logics were modified to meet the requirements of multiple levels.
Fixed the bug that sometimes gold coins would be picked up multiple times
Fixed the BUG of ATM.

We will continue to update in the challenge mode next. Here are some materials for you to take a look at in advance.
With your support and feedback, I will be more motivated to keep making it
